title: frappe-nix app standards profile
description: A built-in or org profile (docs/app-standards/spec.md §8.1). Unknown keys are errors. Module parameters marked x-app-only may be set only in an app's [tool.frappe-nix]. Each default is the value a key gets when no layer sets it (§8.4); they are the recommended values.
